business_rules: Accounts are identified by email address, evaluated case-insensitively for lookup while preserving original capitalization for display.
A user must verify email address ownership before their account is treated as fully active.
Password reset mechanisms must use temporary links, invalidate previous links upon reset, and prevent user-enumeration by not revealing whether an email exists.
Password changes must invalidate all existing active user sessions.
Account deactivation must maintain historical references and audit entries without granting new access.

functions.signature: register_account(email: str, password: str) -> dict
functions.purpose: Registers a new user account and initiates email verification.

functions.signature: verify_email(verification_token: str) -> bool
functions.purpose: Verifies account email ownership using a temporary verification token.

functions.signature: request_password_reset(email: str) -> None
functions.purpose: Initiates a password reset workflow without exposing account existence.

functions.signature: reset_password(reset_token: str, new_password: str) -> bool
functions.purpose: Resets the user password using a valid temporary token and revokes active sessions.

functions.signature: deactivate_account(user_id: str) -> bool
functions.purpose: Deactivates a user account while retaining historical references across organizations.

business_rules: Organizations act as strict multi-tenant boundaries; access to one organization grants no access to another.
Initial creator becomes the organization owner; ownership can be explicitly transferred to another active member.
Invitations are sent via email using temporary tokens; accepting an invitation links existing accounts without creating duplicate identities.
Member removal immediately revokes access but leaves historical activities, comments, and item assignments intact.
Updating organization timezone adjusts calendar presentations without modifying historical UTC timestamps.

functions.signature: create_organization(name: str, owner_id: str, timezone: str = 'UTC') -> dict
functions.purpose: Creates a new organization tenant and sets the initial owner.

functions.signature: invite_member(org_id: str, email: str, inviter_id: str) -> dict
functions.purpose: Sends an organization invitation token to a target email address.

functions.signature: accept_invitation(invitation_token: str, user_id: str) -> bool
functions.purpose: Processes invitation acceptance and adds user to organization membership.

functions.signature: revoke_invitation(org_id: str, invitation_id: str, admin_id: str) -> bool
functions.purpose: Revokes an outstanding pending organization invitation.

functions.signature: transfer_ownership(org_id: str, current_owner_id: str, new_owner_id: str) -> bool
functions.purpose: Transfers tenant ownership to another active organization member.

functions.signature: remove_member(org_id: str, member_id: str, admin_id: str) -> bool
functions.purpose: Removes a member from the organization while preserving historical activity.

business_rules: Project names are scoped to organizations and do not require global uniqueness.
Project access is separate from organization membership; non-members cannot join projects.
Archiving removes projects from active working views while preserving read access for authorized users; completion indicates reached goals.
Project deletion is a destructive operation that must handle dependent work items, comments, attachments, and activity history without leaving orphaned data.
Removing a project member revokes project access but preserves assigned work items and recorded activities.

functions.signature: create_project(org_id: str, name: str, creator_id: str, description: str = None, due_date: str = None) -> dict
functions.purpose: Creates a new project within an organization and assigns initial ownership.

functions.signature: archive_project(project_id: str, user_id: str) -> bool
functions.purpose: Archives a project to remove it from primary active workspace views.

functions.signature: add_project_member(project_id: str, member_id: str, actor_id: str) -> bool
functions.purpose: Adds an organization member to a specific project.

functions.signature: remove_project_member(project_id: str, member_id: str, actor_id: str) -> bool
functions.purpose: Removes a member from a project without deleting historical contributions.

functions.signature: delete_project(project_id: str, actor_id: str) -> bool
functions.purpose: Permanently deletes a project and safely cleans up dependent entities.

business_rules: A work item belongs to one project and requires at minimum a title and a status.
Initial status states include uncompleted, in-progress, and completed; completed items can be reopened.
Priority uses a small ordered semantic range rather than arbitrary numbers.
Unassigned work items are valid; assignees must be valid project members.
Due dates represent calendar days independent of viewer timezone and can be removed after being set.

functions.signature: create_work_item(project_id: str, title: str, creator_id: str, priority: int, assignee_id: str = None, due_date: str = None) -> dict
functions.purpose: Creates a new work item inside a designated project.

functions.signature: update_work_item_status(work_item_id: str, status: str, user_id: str) -> dict
functions.purpose: Updates work item state and records historical movement.

functions.signature: assign_work_item(work_item_id: str, assignee_id: str, user_id: str) -> dict
functions.purpose: Assigns or reassigns a work item to an authorized project participant.

functions.signature: update_work_item_details(work_item_id: str, title: str = None, description: str = None, priority: int = None, due_date: str = None) -> dict
functions.purpose: Modifies editable work item fields.

functions.signature: reorder_work_items(project_id: str, ordered_item_ids: list) -> bool
functions.purpose: Reorders work items within a project view based on user display preferences.

business_rules: Comments attach directly to work items without threaded replies; bodies are unverified user input requiring safe rendering.
Deleting a comment visually marks content as removed while preserving audit logs.
Attachments inherit work item access controls; knowing an identifier is insufficient to bypass authorization.
Uploaded filenames must be sanitized against path traversal attacks (e.g. ../../) and checked against upload size limits.
File downloads require authorization checks prior to serving content or generating limited-lifetime URLs.

functions.signature: add_comment(work_item_id: str, author_id: str, body: str) -> dict
functions.purpose: Posts a sanitized comment on a work item.

functions.signature: edit_comment(comment_id: str, author_id: str, new_body: str) -> dict
functions.purpose: Edits comment text while keeping original author and timestamp metadata.

functions.signature: delete_comment(comment_id: str, user_id: str) -> bool
functions.purpose: Soft-deletes a comment while leaving an activity record indicator.

functions.signature: upload_attachment(work_item_id: str, file_name: str, file_data: bytes, uploader_id: str, comment_id: str = None) -> dict
functions.purpose: Validates, sanitizes, and uploads an attachment file.

functions.signature: generate_download_url(attachment_id: str, user_id: str) -> str
functions.purpose: Verifies parent resource permissions and returns a temporary download URL.

business_rules: Search enforces exact tenant and project access boundaries, prioritizing useful partial matches over exact title matching.
Search indexing processes project names, project descriptions, work item titles, work item descriptions, and comments asynchronously.
Dashboard displays active projects and work assigned to current user, excluding dominating completed or archived work.
Dashboard metrics are dynamically derived from current accessible data rather than stored as separate source of truth.
Users with no assigned work receive a clear empty state without error codes.

functions.signature: search_operational_content(org_id: str, user_id: str, query: str, page: int = 1) -> dict
functions.purpose: Executes permission-aware search across operational workspace entities.

functions.signature: get_user_dashboard(org_id: str, user_id: str) -> dict
functions.purpose: Generates dashboard summary of active assigned work and recent modifications.

functions.signature: reindex_resource(resource_type: str, resource_id: str) -> bool
functions.purpose: Asynchronously updates search index records following resource changes.

business_rules: Notifications are triggered for relevant events such as item assignment or comment mentions.
Notifications can be marked read without deletion, distinguishing read from unread entries.
Delivery failures in external channels (such as email) must not rollback primary database operations.
Activity history is append-only, recording actors, timestamps, and key state transitions.
Historical logs preserve actor contextual identity even if account display names are updated or deactivated.

functions.signature: create_activity_record(org_id: str, event_type: str, actor_id: str, target_id: str, details: dict) -> dict
functions.purpose: Appends a new event entry to the organization activity log.

functions.signature: get_activity_feed(org_id: str, user_id: str, project_id: str = None, page: int = 1) -> dict
functions.purpose: Fetches a paginated, authorized activity feed.

functions.signature: send_notification(user_id: str, event_type: str, payload: dict) -> bool
functions.purpose: Generates an in-app notification and dispatches optional background email.

functions.signature: mark_notification_as_read(notification_id: str, user_id: str) -> bool
functions.purpose: Updates notification status to read.
